config_desc.app_name: Name displayed in the interface and emails
config_desc.contact_email: Email shown to users to reach the SolidaRoute team
config_desc.app_timezone: Time zone used to display all dates and times in the application
config_desc.admin_deletion_retention_days: Days before permanent deletion after an account is deactivated
config_desc.frontend_language: fr = force French · en = force English · both = free choice
config_desc.max_return_delay_minutes: Maximum delay between departure and return for a round trip
config_desc.safeguard_delay_hours: Hours after departure before the safeguard marks a trip as completed
config_desc.driver_suggestion_radius_km: Search radius used to suggest drivers and display available trips
config_desc.driver_selection_required: If enabled, the user must select a driver before confirming
config_desc.geocoding_region: Geographic zone used for address suggestions (QC = Quebec, FR = France, etc.)
config_desc.max_trip_advance_days: Maximum number of days in advance a trip can be booked (0 = no limit)
config_desc.max_login_attempts: Number of consecutive failed login attempts allowed before the account is automatically locked and suspended
config_desc.password_min_length: Minimum number of characters required for a password
config_desc.password_require_uppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter (A–Z)
config_desc.password_require_lowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter (a–z)
config_desc.password_require_number: Password must contain at least one digit (0–9)
config_desc.password_require_special: Password must contain at least one special character (!@#…)
config_desc.session_timeout_minutes: Inactivity duration before automatic logout (in minutes, 0 = disabled)
config_desc.preferred_driver_response_hours: Hours given to the preferred driver to accept before broadcasting to all nearby drivers
config_desc.min_trip_lead_hours: Minimum hours required between the request and the departure time
config_desc.require_driver_license_doc: If enabled, driver's licence must be uploaded before approval
config_desc.require_driver_insurance_doc: If enabled, insurance proof must be uploaded before approval
config_desc.require_driver_vehicle_registration_doc: If enabled, vehicle registration must be uploaded before approval
config_desc.max_document_size_mb: Maximum file size in MB for uploaded documents (PDF, JPEG, PNG)
config_desc.default_phone_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code shown by default in phone number fields (e.g. CA, US, FR)
config_desc.base_fare: Fixed amount charged for every trip, regardless of distance
config_desc.extra_passenger_fee: Surcharge per additional passenger beyond the first
config_desc.driver_share_percent: Percentage of the total fare paid to the volunteer driver
config_desc.payment_currency: Currency used for all payments on this instance
config_desc.payment_provider: Active payment provider (stripe, manual, mobility, paypal)
config_desc.stripe_publishable_key: Stripe publishable key (pk_...) — safe to expose to the frontend
config_desc.payment_max_retries: Number of automatic charge retry attempts before alerting admins (0 = no retry)
config_desc.message_reply_window_days: Number of days after a trip is completed or cancelled during which participants can still send messages (0 = close chat immediately on trip end)
config_desc.message_retention_days: Number of days to keep trip messages before they are permanently deleted by the safeguard job (0 = keep indefinitely)
config_desc.trip_overlap_buffer_minutes: Estimated duration used to detect schedule conflicts when the actual trip duration is unknown. Increase this value if your trips typically run longer than expected.
config_desc.card_charge_delay_days: Number of days after a trip is completed before the authorized card payment is charged. Set to 0 to charge immediately. This window gives clients time to report issues before being billed.
config_desc.ticket_use_delay_days: Number of days after a trip is completed before the reserved mobility tickets are automatically marked as used. Set to 0 to process immediately. This window allows administrators to cancel a mistakenly completed trip.
config_desc.ticket_payout_delay_days: Number of days a ticket remains in 'used' status before being automatically marked as paid out. Use this to align with your external payment processing schedule.
config_desc.broadcast_cutoff_hours: Hours before departure at which the safeguard stops broadcasting to drivers and cancels the trip. This gives the client time to find an alternative if no driver is found.
config_desc.reminder_hours_before: Hours before departure at which the safeguard sends a reminder email to both the client and the assigned driver. Set to 0 to disable reminders.
